name: @suisya-systems/continuo
description: TypeScript port of interlock: durable control plane, measurement harness, and per-role fencing for a coding-agent organization.
author: suisya-systems <iwama.ryo.0731@gmail.com>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-migrations.mjs && node scripts/copy-spike-schema.mjs && node scripts/copy-roles-document.mjs && node scripts/copy-cli-args-allow-document.mjs && node scripts/copy-fence-hook.mjs && node scripts/copy-role-schema.mjs && node scripts/copy-canary-schema.mjs && node scripts/generate-revision.mjs
scripts.check:package: npm run build && npm run publint && npm run attw
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:native && npm run test && npm run parity && npm run inventory
